results.name: Undo Pill
results.author: arihantcodes_1f7b8c4d
results.description: An inline undo pill that shows a draining countdown ring after a delete action, pausing on hover/focus and firing undo or expire callbacks.

results.name: Undo Countdown Button
results.author: dhxwhy
results.description: Undo countdown button for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui) that turns into an "Undo · 5s" control with a shrinking countdown bar after a click and only commits the action when the window closes. It is built to make destructive or irreversible actions safe without a confirmation dialog, so people act first and can still change their mind. An undo button is a button that delays its side effect for a short window during which the user can cancel; this one runs the countdown with the Web Animations API, rewinds the bar when you click again or press Escape, shows a Restored flash, then a Done check with an accent color before returning to idle. Supports undoWindow and resetAfter timing, onStart, onCommit and onUndo callbacks, controlled state, default, destructive and outline variants, three sizes, keyboard activation, aria-live announcements, and reduced motion. Use it for delete, send, archive, publish, and payment actions in SaaS apps, email clients, and admin dashboards. The included demo scripts three sample actions; the component makes no requests. Requires React and lucide-react, with no animation library.

results.name: Undo Feedback
results.author: sltowl
results.description: A dismissible "item removed" snackbar card with an Undo button that shows pending, restored and error states while an async restore action runs, ported from SL UI Library's vanilla-JS Matte Feedback kit (MIT, credit to original author SLtowl).

results.author: reuno-ui
results.description: A draggable floating button that shows page scroll progress as a circular progress ring with an animated percentage counter.

results.name: Scroll Progress Bar
results.author: bundui
results.description: The Scroll Progress Bar component enhances user experience by providing a visually dynamic indicator as the user scrolls through the page. It visually informs users how much of the page has been scrolled, making it especially useful for longer content. Unlike static progress bars, this animated indicator offers a more modern and interactive experience. The scroll bar can be configured as a circular or linear bar and can be positioned in specific corners of the page, such as the bottom-right or top-left. Built using Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS, the Scroll Progress Bar ensures smooth transitions and an aesthetically pleasing design.
